voice.name: Open Sector - Submarine
voice.description: Middle-aged male submarine captain in his forties, speaking in a low hushed near-whisper as if the enemy could hear through the hull, calm, tense and calculating, dry and slightly gravelly voice with a clipped northern European accent, every word measured and precise, a cold patient hunter.
voice.sample: Quiet, everyone. Periscope depth. I see her... a fat merchant, three thousand meters, steady course. Flood tubes one and two. We wait. Patience is the only weapon that never runs dry.

ready: Submarine commissioned. Air is fresh, for now.

fire.prompt: Submarine torpedo launch underwater, sharp compressed air whoosh from the tube followed by a rush of bubbles and a fading propeller whine, close, no music, no voice

move.prompt: Submarine diesel-electric engine humming up and propeller churning water, muffled hull creak, close, no music, no voice

die.prompt: Submarine hull breaching under water pressure, metal groaning and cracking, muffled explosion, water rushing in and big bubbles rising, sinking, no music, no voice

special.prompt: Submarine dive alarm klaxon sounding twice, followed by ballast tanks venting and flooding with a loud rush of water and air, close, no music, no voice
